metadata.player_name_policy: Curated football display names; raw provider names remain in the normalized source data.
metadata.data_note: Real free EPL player-season data from Understat, filtered to players with 450+ minutes. Metrics cover attacking and creative style: xG, xA, shots, key passes, move involvement, and buildup play. Defensive actions, carries, pressures, and progressive passes are not available in this free source.
